source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied). burst.companionDmg1-4 (Wolf's Bite lightning strikes proc'd on Normal Attack hits 1-4) manually derived from GO's actual sheet formula (libs/gi/sheets/src/Characters/Razor/index.tsx): companionDmg{n}_mult = normal.{n}_mult (Lv10) x burst companionDmg scalar (skillParam_gen.burst[1], Lv13 = 0.51); the formula/data.ts stub for Razor is an unmigrated placeholder and was not the source. constellation6.dmg (Lupus Fulguris lightning strike) = flat 100% ATK Electro DMG (GO: `prod(percent(dm.constellation6.dmg), input.total.atk)`, dm.constellation6.dmg = 1), untagged by any normal/skill/burst dmgBonusKey per GO's customDmgNode('elemental', ...) categorization — only electro_dmg_/all_dmg_ apply. lockedPassive.dmg (v6.2 Hexerei: Secret Rite AoE lightning strike, requires 2+ Hexerei party members + Witch's Homework: Of the Little Wolf Pack) = flat 150% ATK Electro DMG (GO: `skillParam_gen.lockedPassive[1][0]` = 1.5, gated `tally.hexerei>=2` + `condLockHomework`), same untagged 'elemental' categorization as C6. The companion Wolf Within +70% ATK flat DMG bonus (`skillParam_gen.lockedPassive[0][0]` = 0.7, GO's `lock_burst_dmgInc`) is passed ONLY into companionDmg1-4's `premod.burst_dmgInc` (NOT into burst.dmg) — modeled via each companionDmg hit's `flatDmgIncFromAtkRatioKeys: ["razorWolfWithinDmgIncFromAtk_"]` plus the buffs.self_conditional_modifiers_json `hexereiWolfWithinDmgInc` entry, so it never leaks onto Razor's own Lightning Fang hit. Energy restore (7) and the 1s internal cooldown on the AoE strike are not modeled (no dmg-formula effect).

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Hunger: when Razor's Energy is below 50%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.
C1 Wolf's Instinct: picking up an Elemental Orb or Particle increases Razor's DMG by 10% for 8s.
C2 Suppression: increases CRIT Rate against opponents with less than 30% HP by 10%.

v6.2 Hexerei: Secret Rite (requires 2+ Hexerei characters in the party and completing Witch's Homework: Of the Little Wolf Pack): while The Wolf Within (burst) is active, its coordinated-attack hits (companionDmg1-4) deal bonus DMG equal to 70% of Razor's ATK.

C6 Lupus Fulguris: for 15s after Razor consumes Electro Sigils (gained from Claw and Thunder or the periodic lightning-charged Normal Attack), his CRIT Rate is increased by 10% and CRIT DMG by 50%. The periodic lightning strike itself (100% ATK Electro DMG every 10s) is modeled separately as the constellation6.dmg hit.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C4 Bite: when casting Claw and Thunder (Press), opponents hit have their DEF decreased by 15% for 7s. Modeled as a party-wide buff so it applies whether Razor is the scored character or a support.

auto.name: Steel Fang
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Claw and Thunder
skill.desc: Hunts his prey using the techniques taught to him by his master and his lupical. Press Swings the Thunder Wolf Claw, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in front of Razor. Upon striking an opponent, Razor will gain an Electro Sigil, which increases his Energy Recharge rate. Razor can have up to 3 Electro Sigils simultaneously, and gaining a new Electro Sigil refreshes their duration. Hold Gathers Electro energy to unleash a lightning storm over a small AoE, causing massive Electro DMG, and clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils. Each Electro Sigil cleared in this manner will be converted into Energy for Razor. In the moment when lightning strikes, you can sometimes glimpse the look of a predator sizing up his prey deep within Razor's eyes.

burst.name: Lightning Fang
burst.desc: Summons the Wolf Within, which deals Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. This clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils, which will be converted into Elemental Energy for him. The Wolf Within will fight alongside Razor for the skill's duration. The Wolf Within · Strikes alongside Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG. · Raises Razor's ATK SPD and Electro RES. · Causes Razor to be immune to DMG inflicted by the Electro-Charged status. · Disables Razor's Charged Attacks. · Increases Razor's resistance to interruption. These effects end when Razor leaves the battlefield. When Razor leaves the field, a maximum of 10 Energy will be returned to him based off the duration remaining on this skill. The wolf has awoken. The hunt is on.

passives.name: Awakening
passives.desc:
Decreases <k>Claw and Thunder</k>'s CD by 18%.
Using <k>Lightning Fang</k> resets the CD of <k>Claw and Thunder</k>.

passives.name: Hunger
passives.desc: When Razor's Energy is below 50%, increases Energy Recharge by 30%.

passives.name: Wolvensprint
passives.desc:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Surge of Lightning
passives.desc:
After completing <k>Witch's Homework: Of the Little Wolf Pack</k>, Razor will become a <k>Hexerei</k> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.
Additionally, Razor's Elemental Burst <k>Lightning Fang</k> is enhanced: <k>The Wolf Within</k>'s DMG dealt is increased by 70% of Razor's ATK.

<k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k>
While the Wolf Within summoned by Razor's Elemental Burst <k>Lightning Fang</k> is active, if the Electro Sigils from Razor's Elemental Skill <k>Claw and Thunder</k> overflow, the Wolf Within will call down a lightning strike on nearby enemies, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 150% of Razor's ATK and restoring 7 Energy to Razor. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

constellations.name: Wolf's Instinct
constellations.desc: Picking up an Elemental Orb or Particle increases Razor's DMG by 10% for 8s.

constellations.name: Suppression
constellations.desc: Increases CRIT Rate against opponents with less than 30% HP by 10%.

constellations.name: Soul Companion
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Lightning Fang</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bite
constellations.desc: When casting <k>Claw and Thunder</k> (Press), opponents hit will have their DEF decreased by 15% for 7s.

constellations.name: Sharpened Claws
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Claw and Thunder</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Lupus Fulguris
constellations.desc:
Every 10s, Razor's sword charges up, causing the next Normal Attack to release lightning that deals 100% of Razor's ATK as <e:electro>Electro DMG</e>.
When Razor is not using <k>Lightning Fang</k>, lightning strikes on an opponent will grant 3 Electro Sigils for his Elemental Skill <k>Claw and Thunder</k>.
Additionally, when Razor gains Electro Sigils through his Elemental Skill <k>Claw and Thunder</k>, he will gain 3 Sigils instead.
For 15s after consuming Electro Sigils, Razor's CRIT Rate is increased by 10% and CRIT DMG by 50%.

auto.name: Croc d'acier
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 4 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance de façon continue pour exécuter une succession d'attaques tournoyantes contre les ennemis proches.
L'attaque chargée se termine sur un coup puissant.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Griffe et tonnerre
skill.desc: Razor met à profit les enseignements de son maître et de son lupical pour chasser sa proie. Appui simple D'un coup de griffe du loup de tonnerre, il inflige des DGT Électro aux ennemis en face. Razor obtient un sceau Électro lorsque cette attaque touche un ennemi, chaque sceau lui conférant un bonus de recharge d'énergie. Razor peut cumuler jusqu'à 3 sceaux Électro, chaque nouveau sceau réinitialisant leur durée. Appui long Amassant la puissance du tonnerre, Razor libère une explosion électrique, infligeant d'importants DGT Électro aux ennemis proches, et supprimant tous les sceaux Électro. Chaque sceau ainsi supprimé est converti en énergie élémentaire. Parfois un malheureux peut apercevoir à la lueur de l'éclair le regard de prédateur de Razor.

burst.name: Croc éclair
burst.desc: Le loup de tonnerre qui sommeille se réveille et vient à la rescousse, infligeant des DGT Électro aux ennemis proches. Ceci supprime également tous les sceaux Électro, qui sont convertis en énergie élémentaire. Le loup de tonnerre combat aux côtés de Razor tant qu'il est actif. Loup de tonnerre · Attaque lorsque Razor effectue une attaque normale, et inflige des DGT Électro. · Augmente la VIT d'attaque ainsi que la RÉS Électro de Razor. · Razor est immunisé aux DGT d'Électrocution. · Attaque chargée impossible. · Augmente la RÉS à l'interruption de Razor. Le loup de tonnerre disparaît lorsque Razor est vaincu ou quitte le champ de bataille. Le temps restant est converti en énergie élémentaire (10 pts maximum) lorsque Razor quitte le champ de bataille. Le loup s'est réveillé. L'heure de la chasse a sonné.

passives.name: Éveil
passives.desc:
Diminue le TdR de <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> de 18 %.
<k>Croc éclair</k> réinitialise le TdR de <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> lorsqu'il est activé.

passives.name: Famine
passives.desc: Razor bénéficie d'un bonus de recharge d'énergie de 30 % lorsque son énergie élémentaire est inférieure à 50 %.

passives.name: Vélocité lupine
passives.desc:
Diminue la consommation d'endurance des personnages de l'équipe de 20 % lors du sprint.
Ne peut pas être cumulé avec d'autres aptitudes passives aux effets identiques.

passives.name: Veillée de la sorcière : Déferlement de foudre
passives.desc:
Après avoir terminé le <k>devoir de la sorcière « De la petite meute »</k>, Razor devient un personnage <k>héxère</k>. Si l'équipe contient au moins 2 personnages héxères, elle bénéficie de l'effet <k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k> qui améliore les personnages héxères.
De plus, le déchaînement élémentaire <k>Croc éclair</k> de Razor est renforcé : les DGT infligés par le <k>loup de tonnerre</k> augmentent d'une valeur équivalant à 70 % de l'ATQ de Razor.

<k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k>
Si la quantité de sceaux Électro de la compétence élémentaire <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> dépasse la limite pendant la durée du loup de tonnerre invoqué par le déchaînement élémentaire <k>Croc éclair</k>, le loup de tonnerre déclenche un éclair sur les ennemis à proximité, infligeant des DGT Électro de zone d'une valeur équivalant à 150 % de l'ATQ de Razor et restaurant 7 pts d'énergie élémentaire à Razor. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les secondes.

constellations.name: Nature du loup
constellations.desc: Razor inflige 10 % de DGT supplémentaires pendant 8 s lorsqu'il obtient un orbe ou une particule élémentaire.

constellations.name: Répression
constellations.desc: Le taux CRIT de Razor augmente de 10 % quand il attaque des ennemis dont les PV sont inférieurs à 30 %.

constellations.name: Âme de loup
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Croc éclair</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Morsure
constellations.desc: L'appui simple de <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> diminue la DÉF des cibles de 15 % pendant 7 s.

constellations.name: Griffes tranchantes
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Lupus Fulguris
constellations.desc:
Toutes les 10 s, l'arme de Razor se charge d'énergie électrique pour infliger des <e:electro>DGT Électro</e> d'une valeur équivalant à 100 % de l'ATQ de Razor lors de la prochaine attaque normale.
Chaque ennemi touché confère à Razor 3 sceaux Électro de la compétence élémentaire <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k> tant que <k>Croc éclair</k> n'est pas actif.
De plus, lorsque Razor gagne un sceau Électro grâce à sa compétence élémentaire <k>Griffe et tonnerre</k>, il obtient 3 sceaux Électro à la place.
Pendant 15 s après avoir consommé un sceau Électro, le taux CRIT de Razor augmente de 10 % et ses DGT CRIT augmentent de 50 %.

auto.name: Presa de Aço
auto.desc:
<k>Ataque Normal</k>
Realiza até 4 golpes consecutivos.

<k>Ataque Carregado</k>
Drena Stamina ao longo do tempo para realizar um ataque giratório contínuo contra todos os inimigos próximos.
Ao final da sequência, realiza um corte poderoso.

<k>Ataque Imersivo</k>
Mergulha em pleno ar para golpear o chão, danificando inimigos em seu caminho e infligindo Dano em uma AdE durante o impacto.

skill.name: Garra e Trovão
skill.desc: Caça sua presa usando as técnicas ensinadas para ele por seu mestre e seu Lupical. Pressionar Balança suas Garras de Lobo do Trovão, causando Dano Electro nos inimigos em frente do Razor. Ao atacar um inimigo, Razor ganha um Selo Electro que aumenta sua taxa de Recarga de Energia. Razor pode ter até 3 Selos Electro simultaneamente, e ganhar um novo Selo Electro recarrega sua duração. Manter pressionado Reúne energia Electro para desencadear uma tempestade de raios em uma pequena AdE, causando Dano Electro massivo e removendo todos os Selos Electro de Razor. Cada Selo Electro removido dessa maneira será convertido em Energia para o Razor. É quando relâmpagos caem que às vezes você pode ver de relance o olhar de um predador, analisando sua presa profundamente dentro dos olhos do Razor.

burst.name: Dente de Relâmpago
burst.desc: Evoca o Lobo Interior que causa Dano Electro a todos os inimigos ao redor. Isso remove todos os Selos Electro do Razor, que serão convertidos em energia elemental para ele. O Lobo Interior irá lutar ao lado de Razor durante o período de duração da habilidade. O Lobo Interior Ataca juntamente com os ataques normais do Razor, causando Dano Electro. Aumenta a Vel. de ATQ e RES Electro. Causa imunidade a Razor por Dano infligido pelo estado de Eletricamente Carregado Desabilita o Ataque Carregado do Razor. Aumenta a capacidade de RES à Interrupção de Razor. Esses efeitos terminam quando Razor sai de batalha. Quando Razor deixa o campo, um máximo de 10 de Energia irá ser retornada para ele baseado na duração restante da habilidade. O lobo acordou. A caça começou.

passives.name: Despertamento
passives.desc: Diminui a Recarga da <k>Garra e Trovão</k> em 18%. Usar <k>Dente de Relâmpago</k> redefine a Recarga da <k>Garra e Trovão</k>.

passives.name: Fome
passives.desc: Quando a Energia de Razor está abaixo de 50%, aumenta a Recarga de Energia em 30%.

passives.name: Corrida de Lobos
passives.desc:
Diminui o consumo de Stamina ao Correr de todos os seus personagens em 20%.
Não acumulável com Talentos Passivos que concedem exatamente os mesmos efeitos.

passives.name: Presente da Noite da Bruxa: Torrente Elétrica
passives.desc:
Depois de completar <k>Tarefa da Bruxa: Dos Pequenos Lobos</k>, Razor se torna um personagem <k>Mágico</k>. Quando possuir pelo menos 2 personagens Mágicos na equipe, obtém o efeito <k>Mágico: Ritual Secreto</k>, fortalecendo os personagens Mágicos.
Além disso, o Supremo <k>Dente de Relâmpago</k> de Razor é fortalecido: aumenta o Dano causado de <k>Lobo do Trovão</k> em 70% do ATQ de Razor.

<k>Mágico: Ritual Secreto</k>
Durante a invocação do Lobo do Trovão do Supremo <k>Dente de Relâmpago</k>, se os Selos Electro da Habilidade Elemental de Razor <k>Garra e Trovão</k> sobre-acumularem, o Lobo do Trovão causará ataques de raios elétricos contra os inimigos próximos equivalente a 150% do ATQ de Razor como Dano Electro em AdE, e regenera 7 de Energia Elemental para Razor. Esse efeito pode ser desencadeado uma vez por segundo.

constellations.name: Natureza do Lobo
constellations.desc: Ao obter um Orbe Elemental ou Partícula Elemental, aumenta o Dano de Razor em 10% por 8s.

constellations.name: Supressão
constellations.desc: Aumenta a Taxa Crítica contra inimigos com menos de 30% de Vida em 10%.

constellations.name: Espírito Animal
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível do <k>Dente de Relâmpago</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Mordida
constellations.desc: Ao pressionar para lançar a <k>Garra e Trovão</k>, diminui a DEF dos inimigos acertados em 15% por 7s.

constellations.name: Garras Afiadas
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível da <k>Garra e Trovão</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Lupus Fulguris
constellations.desc:
A cada 10 segundos, o Espadão de Razor será recarregado automaticamente, fazendo com que o próximo Ataque Normal invoque um relâmpago que causa 100% do seu ATQ como <e:electro>Dano Electro</e>.
Quando Razor não estiver sob o efeito de <k>Dente de Relâmpago</k>, se o relâmpago atingir um inimigo, Razor ganhará 3 Selos Electro de <k>Garra e Trovão</k>.
Além disso, quando Razor acumular Selo Electro através de sua Habilidade Elemental <k>Garra e Trovão</k>, fornecerá 3 Selos Electro para ele.
Por 15s após consumir Selo Electro, a Taxa CRIT de Razor aumenta 10% e o Dano CRIT em 50%.

auto.name: 钢脊
auto.desc:
<k>普通攻击</k>
进行至多四段的连续挥砍。

<k>重击</k>
持续消耗体力，旋转大剑攻击周围的敌人。
停止旋转时，会进行一次格外有力的挥砍。

<k>下落攻击</k>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。

skill.name: 利爪与苍雷
skill.desc: 用师父与他的「家人」教他的方法，来解决猎物。 点按 向前挥动雷狼之爪，对前方的敌人造成雷元素伤害。 若命中敌人，则会为雷泽积攒一个雷之印，提高雷泽的元素充能效率。 最多同时存在3个雷之印，叠加刷新持续时间。 长按 积聚雷电力量引发小范围的雷爆，造成大量雷元素伤害，并清除已有的雷之印。 每个因此被清除的雷之印，都会转为雷泽的元素能量。 雷击落下的一瞬，偶尔能瞥见雷泽灵魂深处那头狼打量猎物的眼神。

burst.name: 雷牙
burst.desc: 唤醒无形的雷狼守护自己，对周围的敌人造成雷元素伤害，并消耗所有雷之印，为雷泽恢复元素能量。 雷狼存在期间，会与雷泽共同战斗。 雷狼 · 会随雷泽的普通攻击协同攻击，造成雷元素伤害； · 提高雷泽的攻击速度、雷元素抗性； · 使雷泽免疫感电反应的伤害； · 无法施放重击； · 提高雷泽的抗打断能力。 效果将在雷泽退场时解除。 退场时，会依据剩余的持续时间，返还至多10点元素能量。 狼苏醒了。狩猎的时候到了。

passives.name: 觉醒
passives.desc:
<k>利爪与苍雷</k>的冷却时间减少18%。
施放<k>雷牙</k>时，重置<k>利爪与苍雷</k>的冷却时间。

passives.name: 饥饿
passives.desc: 雷泽的元素能量在50%以下时，元素充能效率提高30%。

passives.name: 奔狼
passives.desc:
队伍中自己的角色冲刺消耗的体力降低20%。
无法与效果完全相同的固有天赋叠加。

passives.name: 魔女的前夜礼·苍雷奔涌
passives.desc:
完成<k>魔女的课业·小狼众之题</k>后，雷泽将成为<k>魔导</k>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<k>魔导·秘仪</k>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。
此外，雷泽的元素爆发<k>雷牙</k>获得强化：<k>雷狼</k>造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于雷泽的攻击力的70%。

<k>魔导·秘仪</k>
元素爆发<k>雷牙</k>唤醒的雷狼存在期间，如果雷泽积攒元素战技<k>利爪与苍雷</k>中的雷之印时发生溢出，雷狼将会引下落雷攻击附近的敌人，造成相当于雷泽150%攻击力的雷元素范围伤害，并为雷泽恢复7点元素能量。每1秒至多触发一次该效果。

constellations.name: 狼性
constellations.desc: 雷泽获取元素晶球或元素微粒后的8秒内，造成的伤害提高10%。

constellations.name: 压制
constellations.desc: 雷泽攻击生命值低于30%的敌人时，暴击率提高10%。

constellations.name: 兽魂
constellations.desc:
<k>雷牙</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 撕咬
constellations.desc: <k>利爪与苍雷</k>点按时，会使命中的敌人防御力降低15%，持续7秒。

constellations.name: 利爪
constellations.desc:
<k>利爪与苍雷</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 天狼
constellations.desc:
每10秒，雷泽的大剑将自动充能，使下一次普通攻击引发落雷，造成100%攻击力的<e:electro>雷元素伤害</e>。
不处于<k>雷牙</k>状态下时，若落雷击中敌人，会为雷泽积攒三个元素战技<k>利爪与苍雷</k>中的雷之印。
此外，雷泽通过元素战技<k>利爪与苍雷</k>积攒雷之印时，会改为为雷泽积攒三个雷之印。
消耗雷之印后的15秒内，雷泽的暴击率提升10%，暴击伤害提升50%。
